posts.title: Guitar Chops 01
posts.description: A couple of months ago, I got lost in Starfield. I didn’t do much else, and I hardly played my guitar. It’s only been a kind of “secondary hobby” since about 2015, so that’s hardly surprising, and the amount of time spent playing has been fluctuating a lot that whole time. Around that time, a dear old friend (and former band mate) approached me with a suggestion: let’s each pick a riff/phrase/part
